Q. In 2021, the leadership of country X proposed a radical architectural marvel: a circular metropolis to be built at the very base of Conchagua, a volcano. This planned settlement was designed to have no income, no property, and no capital gains taxes, functioning instead as a highly productive haven for a new generation. The lifeblood of this city was to be a massive geothermal plant that would harness the intense, subterranean heat of the volcano to fuel the state’s sudden need for huge amounts of power, thanks to a landmark law passed earlier that year. *Id X and what was the purpose of this project.*
El Salvador was the first country to make it legal tender
Correct. This was El Salvador, the first sovereign entity to accept bitcoin as a legal tender
